seo.title: AI receptionist case studies | Steps AI
seo.description: What an AI receptionist from Steps AI does on phone calls, with customer stories to follow.

hero.title: An AI receptionist that answers your calls.
hero.body: Steps AI can now answer phone calls in English, Hindi and Telugu. Customer stories for the AI receptionist are being gathered, and this page will share them as they come in.

items.title: Answer inbound calls
items.body: Calls are routed to the right agent by the number dialled, and known callers are greeted by name.

items.title: Take messages after hours
items.body: Calls outside business hours leave a voicemail that becomes a callback ticket for your team.

items.title: Transfer to a person
items.body: When a caller needs your team, the call can be transferred to a human.

items.title: Speak your customers’ language
items.body: Voice works in English, Hindi and Telugu, on the web and on real phone calls.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: These stories are in each customer’s own words. Full case studies with figures will be added once they are confirmed with each customer.
Voice minutes are billed as credits, and a telephony provider is connected from the dashboard.

cta.title: See the AI receptionist work for your business.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using your own information.
